bead.title: claude-tui/step3: PTY transport — Execute path with startup-probe responder + bracketed-paste prompt delivery
bead.description:
Replace the stub Execute with the real PTY path.

WORK:
- Use internal/pty/session to spawn 'claude' (no --print, no -p, no --output-format, no other batch flags).
- Implement a small startup-probe responder for DA1/DA2/DSR/XTVERSION/window-size queries the Ink TUI emits at startup. Belongs in internal/pty/ as a reusable helper (the quota probe path consumes it too).
- Deliver prompts via bracketed paste (ESC[200~ ... ESC[201~ + Enter). Single keystrokes for slash commands/menu navigation use a 25-75ms inter-key delay band.
- Env allowlist per ADR-013 §Environment Allowlist: pass-through HOME/PATH/USER/LOGNAME/SHELL/LANG/LC_ALL/TZ/XDG_*/CLAUDE_*; set TERM/LANG/LC_ALL defaults if absent. Drop everything else.
- Cancellation: Esc by default; Ctrl-C fallback restarts the session.

NON-SCOPE: JSONL transcript parsing (sub-bead step 4); session pool (sub-bead step 6); model/reasoning selection drivers (sub-bead step 5).
bead.acceptance:
1) internal/pty/probes/ (or equivalent) ships a reusable startup-probe responder for DA1/DA2/DSR/XTVERSION/window-size; quota probe path either refactored to consume it OR a follow-up bead is filed (name it in the closing note).
2) claude-tui Runner.Execute starts a PTY session against claude (binary path resolved via PATH), sends a multi-line prompt via bracketed paste, and observes the prompt echo. Verified by a unit test using a synthetic PTY echo program.
3) Bracketed-paste correctness assertion: the prompt bytes appear inside ESC[200~ ... ESC[201~ markers exactly once; no leakage outside; multi-line prompts arrive as a single burst (no per-byte delay inside paste).
4) Inter-key delay band configurable (default 25-75ms); enforced for single keystrokes via a measurable test.
5) Env allowlist enforced: assertion test (a) asserts the documented allowed set is passed; (b) asserts unknown env vars are dropped; (c) asserts no Fizeau-introduced CLAUDE_*, ANTHROPIC_*, *_AGENT*, *_AUTOMATED* variables appear in the spawned process environment.
6) Cassette round-trip: a record-mode test against the synthetic PTY echo program produces a cassette that, when replayed via internal/pty/cassette, yields identical Events.
7) Cancellation paths verified: Esc cancels the turn (final event with Status='cancelled'); Ctrl-C closes the session and the runner reports an error.
8) go test ./internal/harnesses/claude-tui/... ./internal/pty/... -count=1 green.
